support_jake: FYI escalation from ACME — deletion API /v1/privacy/erase returning 401 for tenant 'acme-prod'. Customer says KMS logs show 'AccessDenied', but they use a dedicated CMK. Also seeing billing duplicates from retries. Need sec + SRE help :eyes:
eng_sre_lynn: can you paste the request id/trace id and a minimal repro (curl) and the exact error body?
support_jake: trace_id=trace-acme-20260315-11. Customer sent this curl (redacted):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/privacy/erase" \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \ 
  -H 'X-Tenant-ID: acme-prod' \ 
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: 123e4567' \ 
  -d '{"user_id":"u-98765","reason":"gdpr_erasure"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"kms:Decrypt failed","code":"KMS_ACCESS_DENIED","request_id":"trace-acme-20260315-11"}
Also billing: customer says they were charged twice for embeddings when client retried after 401.
srebot: :robot_face: New trace linked: trace-acme-20260315-11 -> /traces/trace-acme-20260315-11
security_eli: Quick clarifying Qs: is this an incoming DPA erasure request (no legal hold)? Do we know if the CMK was rotated recently or rewrapped? Need KMS key ARN and CloudTrail/KMS audit log window (estimate). We need to preserve logs for compliance.
customer_acme_ops: Confirming: this is a customer-initiated erasure, no legal hold. We rotated the CMK yesterday evening (2026-03-14 22:10 UTC). Key alias: alias/acme-prod-eraser. Deletion must complete.
eng_oncall_maya: Thanks. Likely vector: key rotation changed key policy or the dedicated tenant's key grant wasn't re-applied to the Redwood service principal. Two parallel issues: 1) KMS AccessDenied causing 401 on erase path; 2) client retries without idempotency caused duplicate billing. Steps to repro locally (internal):
1) call erase with tenant header and a CMK that lacks decrypt grants for redwood-service principal.
2) observe 401 from API and backend kms:Decrypt error in logs.
Can someone pull CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt around 2026-03-14 22:00-23:00 for alias/acme-prod-eraser and the KMS key ID.
security_eli: Also need HSM audit if key is in an HSM-backed cluster. Please attach KMS key id and whether key material is customer-managed (CMK) vs redwood-managed. We must collect evidence for the GDPR DPA: timestamps, request IDs, and admin user who rotated the key. Don't perform destructive ops yet.
support_jake: Attached logs from customer (they sanitized some things):
```
2026-03-15T11:02:03Z TRACE trace-acme-20260315-11 API /v1/privacy/erase 401 kms:Decrypt failed key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
2026-03-15T11:02:04Z CLIENT acme-prod retry attempt=2 idempotency=missing
```
eng_sre_lynn: pulling RBAC/key-grant state now. If rotation removed the grant we can reapply grant to redwood-service principal and replay the delete. Also we'll add a guard to return 429 or 503 on transient KMS auth problems instead of passing 401 to clients — avoids client retries leading to duplicate billing.
legal_paul: Please confirm we pause any irreversible steps until legal ok for audit chain. We need preserved logs and proof of deletion after fix.
customer_acme_ops: Legal confirmed no hold. Proceed. We need deletion proof when done.
eng_sre_lynn: Grant re-applied to key abcd-ef01 for redwood-service principal at 2026-03-15T12:10:22Z, re-run erase in staging, replayed trace-acme-20260315-11 against dedicated tenant, erase succeeded. Will schedule production replay in next maintenance window (~2h).
security_eli: Collected CloudTrail events and KMS key rotation metadata, saved to secure evidence bucket (audit-evidence/acme/2026-03-15). Added HSM access log snapshot.
support_jake: Noted duplicate charges: Finance confirms two embedding units billed for the two attempts. Action: refund duplicate commit for acme-prod and patch API to enforce idempotency on erase endpoint (require Idempotency-Key) and to treat transient KMS auth as retryable internally.
eng_oncall_maya: Patch merged to require Idempotency-Key header for destructive endpoints and to map kms:Decrypt AccessDenied to 503 when it appears transient (we'll add a feature flag). Rolling to prod in 2h.
srebot: :white_check_mark: Prod rollout scheduled at 2026-03-15T14:30:00Z by eng_oncall_maya (ci-deploy-4921).
support_jake: Customer notified: will confirm when production replay completes and provide deletion evidence bundle (CloudTrail + KMS audit + operation log + signed deletion receipt).
customer_acme_ops: Thanks, please zip the evidence and include an assertion of deletion timestamp.
security_eli: Once deletion verified, we will append the evidence to the DPA compliance folder and notify Data Protection Officer.
support_jake: UPDATE: production replay completed successfully at 2026-03-15T14:35:07Z, erase returned 200, logs collected. Preparing evidence bundle now. Closing escalation once refund and evidence delivered. :white_check_mark:
